description.value: Tractor Foods is a BC-born healthy fast-casual chain founded in 2013, serving scratch-made salads, soups, breakfast bowls, and sandwiches with a focus on local and plant-forward ingredients. The Victoria Harbour outpost on Government Street sits in the heart of downtown Victoria's main tourist and commercial corridor — a practical refuelling stop for cyclists riding through the city centre. Online ordering with quick pickup turnaround makes it easy to grab a meal without a long wait.
